forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 39 of September, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Teams completed 2 visits, with no zone surveys, technical surveys or clearances finished. So far, 27 zones have been surveyed and 9 declared free; 28 areas have been released and 13 cleared.

No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. The access feed shows 8 zones closed. No dossiers were held, and no reports were held or queried. Plan P09 remains in place; no new plan was approved. There are 578 suspected or confirmed areas still open.

The forecast made in week 36 covers the zones of the plan it was made with, counting what is done already. Its P10 to P90 range is 11 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 10 zones declared free this season.
